rights.jurisdiction_notes: Charles Raymond Macauley died in 1934. The source records expressly warn that a small number of jurisdictions use terms longer than life plus 70 and may not apply the rule of the shorter term. Any future canonical promotion must retain this territorial note and use Earnalism's approved distribution-jurisdiction policy; this private packet does not make a worldwide legal conclusion.
